notes.title: Siren's Call: Escape Velocity is nearly complete!
notes.content:
It's been a while since my last update, but trust me when I say the wait has not been for nothing. Siren's Call: Escape Velocity has now been programmed and tested to the point where I am now confident in its quality. While not technically 100% complete yet, only the translations and new music have yet to be added (these are still being worked on). Essentially, as the programmer, I've done nearly everything I can do with what I have. About every bug I could find over this 6 year period has been fixed (I hope) and it is completely playable from start to finish. We are in the end game. 

There are just a few things left:

1. The two translations (Spanish and German)

2. All the new music being made/incorporated 

Other than that, we are essentially done! I'm talking with Steam about bringing the game to early access soon so you guys won't have to wait much longer. I cannot WAIT to see what you all think of what we've made. 

Until then, stay sweet everyone.

Yours,
Jacob
